dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm sure Sudabeh will grow up to be a great distinguished lady!

dialogues.speaker: Sudabeh
dialogues.text: #Thanks, {NICKNAME}! I'm learning really hard! To become a distinguished lady sooner, I'm learning how to cook!

dialogues.speaker: Sudabeh
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, have a taste of the curry I made! My father and brother all thought it was good after they tried it!

dialogues.speaker: Sudabeh
dialogues.text: They told me not to cook this too often because it's worth being cherished since it's too delicious, but I will surely keep cooking it!
